title: Hinomori Shiho — Concealed Joy〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Odaiba Animal Land
se_run_women_002_1
se_run_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, Ichika, thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry about making you two wait until our shadowing was finished.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. We haven't been waiting long.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We got to see some cool things while we did, too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Then, what should we do now?
Anywhere you guys wanna go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Not in particular...
Actually, do you have any recommendations as zookeepers for the day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... I'd recommend...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I can't choose! Any ideas, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think we should go to the petting zoo.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The petting zoo?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that did sound like fun.
It looked like you could meet a lot of different animals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, Shiho, that sounds like a place you'd really love.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not that much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then, let's check it out.
I'm looking forward to seeing what animals they have there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go!
Uhh... I think it was...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This way. Follow me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you already know the way...?
Petting Zoo

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, they have capibaras and guinea pigs here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And they're in the same pen.
It's interesting how that doesn't really bother them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They seem really relaxed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They kinda look like a big family since they have similar appearances!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're really allowed to pet these guinea pigs?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It is a petting zoo, so it should be fine, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then... I'll try petting this one.
Come here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, they aren't resisting at all...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They must be used to being around people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're so cute... I might try holding one too. But what other animals do they have here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see. Besides guinea pigs and capibaras...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They have rabbits, alpacas and goats.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alpacas?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At a petting zoo? Aren't they pretty big?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I think they're over there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We have to pay to get in, but we'd get to feed them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? Then, it might be worth a visit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I really wanna go...but I think I'll stay here a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, why?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because this one just fell asleep.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, wow... It's sleeping like a baby.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Go on ahead. I'll stay right here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
You might not be able to move for a while if you're going to wait for it to wake up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then... I'll wait.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, we'll head on over.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. I'll catch up once it wakes back up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds good. Then, where should we start?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, based on this pamphlet, they have lop-eared rabbits here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Lop-eared? As in the ones with ears that hang down? They're probably really cute.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Lop-eared rabbits...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you interested, Hinomori?
Would you like to come with us after all?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I don't want to betray my little friend's trust by waking it up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure “betray” is the right word...
